target.control_prompt:
[Verse 1]
I heard about you by chance today
Thought I had moved on, gone my own way
But why does my heart still shake inside
Whenever your name comes to my mind

A promise made in our foolish days
Our love was short, yet it still stays
Though all the years have passed me by
My heart’s still living in that time

[Chorus]
It’s all in the past, I know
But why does it hurt me so
I thought time would wash away
Everything, but here I stay

If I had reached for you back then
If I had tried just once again
Would we be different somehow
I’m still the same right now

They said you’re somewhere near these days
Once we dreamed we’d meet again someday
I swore I’d stand before you proud
But now my hair has turned to clouds

In the mirror, I see my face
Carved by time I can’t erase
Yet in my heart, through all the years
You remain the same, my dear

[Bridge]
I say I’ve let you go
But deep inside, you still glow
Each time your name drifts by
My heart stops and sighs

[Chorus – Reprise]
It’s all in the past, I know
But why does it hurt me so
Time goes on and worlds may change
Still my heart feels just the same

If I had reached for you back then
If I had tried just once again
Would we be different somehow
I’m still the same right now

this obsession with gold,

even temples and prayers,
no respect in the pulpit,
no justice anywhere.

that escapes from the hand.

what we once knew was true,
everything turning upside
while we lost every clue.

that shared human light,
like time stole the rhythm
of our days and our nights.

[Intro - Slow acoustic guitar arpeggio, melancholic piano chords]

[Verse 1 - Soft, intimate male vocals, almost spoken, sparse instrumentation]

The coffee's ready...

Same time as yesterday.

You ask me if I paid the gas bill...

I ask about your day.

We talk about the weather...

We talk about the traffic...

We talk about everything...

Except the deafening static.

[Chorus - Emotional vocals, full acoustic arrangement, piano, double bass]

'Cause we're just strangers...

Sleeping in the same bed.

With the same collection of memories...

Playing in our head.

We built this life together...

Now we're just living in the past.

A perfect, hollow habit...

How long will it last?

We're just strangers... with the same memories.

[Verse 2 - Voice returns to the intimate, tired tone]

We sit on the sofa...

The TV fills the space.

You're scrolling on your phone...

I'm staring at my place.

We say "Goodnight"...

And turn out the bedroom light.

Two backs turned in the darkness...

Too tired for another fight.

[Chorus - Emotional vocals, more powerful, Cello joins, piano, double bass]

'Cause we're just strangers...

Sleeping in the same bed.

With the same collection of memories...

Playing in our head.

We built this life together...

Now we're just living in the past.

A perfect, hollow habit...

How long will it last?

We're just strangers... with the same memories.

[Bridge - Voice is a sad whisper, music builds slowly with cello and piano]

I look at the photos...

Hanging in the hall.

The smiling faces...

Before we built this wall.

When did we stop talking?

When did the silence grow?

We're two ghosts in a museum...

With nowhere left to go.

[Cello Solo - A slow, melodic, and emotional cello solo, full of sorrow]

[Chorus - Final chorus, vocals are powerful and full of resigned pain, full acoustic swell]

'Cause we're just strangers...

Sleeping in the same bed.

With the same collection of memories...

Playing in our head.

We built this life together

target.control_prompt:
[Verse 1]

He was a shadow in the sunrise,
Eyes like storms that never fade.
He spoke in whispers, soft and wordless,
And every word he left me stayed.

[Verse 2]

They say his heart grew cold with time,
That love had turned his soul to stone.
But when he smiled, it felt divine,
And I forgot I was alone.

[silence]
I felt free because—

[Chorus 1]

He’d never let me down,
He’d set my grief on fire.
He wore a broken crown,
He was my one desire.

[Post Chorus 1]
He’s holy... holy...
George’s prayer,
The fallen savior,
He’s fading slowly out to sea.

[instrumental]

[Verse 3]

He was a poet, a lost believer,
A saint in ashes, down on his knees.
He was a sinner, but no deceiver,
He gave his pain like prophecy.

[silence]
Now he’s free.

[Chorus 2]

He’ll never let me down,
He’s gone, but burns like amber.
He’ll never leave this town,
His ghost is what I remember.

[Post Chorus 2]
He’s holy... holy...
George’s prayer,
The fallen savior,
He’s drifting softly out to sea.

[Pre-Bridge]
Holy... holy...
George’s prayer,
If you still see him,
Send my love from me.

[instrumental]

[Bridge]

Holy dreamer, fading teacher,
The sky is crying over you.
Keeper of the lost believers,
Hold your flame and see it through.
Because you’re holy... holy...
You’re holy... holy...

[Chorus / Outro]

Holy... holy...
George’s prayer,
The fallen savior,
He’s sinking slowly to the sea.
Holy... holy...
George’s prayer,
If you still see him,
Say goodbye for me.
target.tags_full: A painfully intimate, sorrow-drenched ballad. The song unfolds slowly — minimal acoustic guitar and cello, with long, aching silences between phrases. The vocal is a deep, raspy male voice, recorded dry and raw, no reverb or effects, as if he’s singing into an old mic in a dark, empty room at midnight. His tone trembles with exhaustion, heartbreak, and quiet resignation. Every word is pronounced clearly but softly, carrying weight, regret, and vulnerability. The mood is bare, fragile, and deeply human — the sound of someone remembering what they’ve lost and knowing there’s no way back. The performance should feel uncomfortably personal, like you’re overhearing a confession meant for no one

[Female Singer]
[Verse 1]
In modems of 300 baud,
I found my lowly start,
Telecom to datacom,
the new tech writer’s art.

Siss-Op of the B.B.S.,
solutions up to me,
The modem screeches on the phone,
The Siss-Op holds the key.
And that was me.
I held the key.

[Verse 3]
From dream ware to vapor ware,
to an all-out back-bench fight,
It's up to the tech writer
to define the future flight.

At that old hi-tech startup,
Oh, the stakes were running high,
Seven teams around the clock,
And yes! I heard their cry.

[Verse 5]
Oh, the chaos runs rampant,
but we can close the loop,
With tight documentation,
we can stabilize the group.

[Verse 6]
“Just swap the vaylence,”
Engineers would pray,
Surfing chaos day and night
In a cybernetic fray
But in the end we did it.

[Chorus]
We saved the day.
With cutting edge technology,
We did.
We saved the day.

[Verse 7]
Oh, the chaos reigns in R. and D.,
we have to close the loop,
We need tight documentation,
not just alphabet soup.

[Verse 8]
Oh, it's dream ware, it's vapor ware,
changing from bit to byte
But we're not improvising,
we're documenting tight.

[Verse 9]
“Swap the vaylence” was the word,
In halls of chaos, all we heard.
But never mind, we saved the day.
With tight documentation,
We did.
We saved the day.

[Outro]
So now we document today
And tell tomorrow what to say.
Same chord progressions, just arranged
and played a whole new way.

target.control_prompt:
🎵 One More Day

(Deep Bass Vocal · Bright Piano Only · Key of G Minor)
Tempo: 68 BPM
Style: Raw, cinematic confessional — every pause matters.

⸻

[Intro – Bright Piano Only]

(Right hand: high G–A–Bb–D notes, slow arpeggios.
Left hand: soft low G octave, gentle sustain pedal.
Play with breath between each phrase.)

⸻

[Verse 1 – Low, breathy tone]

If I had one more day,
I’d tell you all the things I couldn’t say.
The truth I hid when fear took hold,
The words I meant but left untold.

I’d hold your hand until the light gave way,
And whisper that I never meant to let you break.

⸻

[Pre-Chorus – Voice steady, slight lift]

The room still feels like you,
Every shadow speaks your name.

⸻

[Chorus – Gravel and depth, soft piano beneath]

If I had one more day to make it right,
I’d give forever for one more night.
I’d look into your eyes and finally say,
You were my reason — my only way.

(Hold “way” over G minor chord — let it ring into silence.)

⸻

[Verse 2 – Deep, cracked tone]

I still reach for you when the dark gets loud,
Still talk to the air like you’re around.
The mirror doesn’t lie — it just reminds,
What’s left behind in borrowed time.

If I could find you, I’d never let go,
Even if forever said no.

⸻

[Pre-Chorus 2 – Quieter, half-whispered]

I can’t change what I became,
But I’d still whisper your name.

⸻

[Bridge – Deep whisper, eyes closed]

If heaven gave me just a moment’s grace,
I’d trace my hand across your face.
No promises, no grand displays,
Just the truth I failed to say.

(High bright notes — Bb, D, G — spaced like tears hitting glass.)

⸻

[Final Chorus – Deep growl with air, let the notes tremble]

If I had one more day to see you breathe,
I’d give the world just to believe.
I’d pull you close till the night gave way,
And pray the dawn would lose its way.

One more day —
That’s all I’d need.

⸻

[Outro – Bright Piano Only]

(Right hand plays fading notes: G–Bb–D–G.
Left hand: low G held softly with pedal.
Final note rings, fading into silence.)

Banjos pickin', a happy tune..

.. i must kiss you goodnight my Darlin, now... 'cause i need to be in amarillo by noon.

good night my darlin' , god bless you toooo... I need to rise early to be in Amarillo by noon... Amarillo by noon..

[Chorus 1]
Long gone long gone...

[Chorus 2]

Ridin' high on my Truck to get there by noon ...
Amarillo by noon...

[Verse 9]
I'll rise early to be home again by night.. soo good night my Darling... God bless you 'an good night.

[Verse 10]
Banjo pickin',  guitars singing' sweet.
my beautyful wife by my side, i feel like a king,! Like a kiing ...

Im treated like a king in my home by my wife, 'cause my riding the lonesome trucking road all day 'an sometimes through the dark, dark, dark 'n cold. lonsesome night!

lonsesome night! lonsesome night! loooonsesome niight!

She's my light, and the Queen of my heart.... She's real cute, and a warm mother to our kids and she's real real smart...

She's the shining Queen of my heart... Of my lonesome, loan road truckin' heart...

[Verse 18]
...an she'll be in my arms... In my strong loan road truckers arms...
Yahooo... Lone road,  my loan road loving Arms...

target.control_prompt:
[Intro: Warm skank guitar and deep bassline, light shaker]

[Verse 1]
They drew my edges with borrowed lines
Said ‘smile softer, take up less space, align’
I wore their map like a second skin
Till the seams began to split from within

[Verse 2]
No grand rebellion, no shattered glass
Just me untying knots they tied to last
Folded their ‘shoulds’ into paper boats
Watched them sink in my morning coat

[Pre-Chorus]
Not loud, not fast—just steady and true
This voice was always mine, just waiting through

[Chorus]
I breathe, and the world makes room!
No borrowed crown, no borrowed tune!
You thought I’d break beneath the weight?
But I bloom at my own slow rate!

[Inst: Mellow guitar riff over bubbling bass, subtle organ swell]

[Verse 3]
My kitchen light knows my real name
Not the one they called to clip my flame
I stir my tea with a quiet hand
While empires of doubt turn to dust in the land

[Pre-Chorus]
Not perfect—just finally free
To be the shape I’m meant to be

[Chorus]
I breathe, and the world makes room!
No borrowed crown, no borrowed tune!
You thought I’d break beneath the weight?
But I bloom at my own slow rate!

[Bridge]
(whispered)
They asked why I don’t shout
But roots don’t roar—they hold the ground
And every petal I unfold
Is a quiet ‘no’ turned into gold

[Chorus]
I breathe, and the world makes room!
No borrowed crown, no borrowed tune!
You thought I’d break beneath the weight?
But I bloom at my own slow rate!

[Outro: Guitar and bass fade slowly, vocal hums linger]
(breathe… bloom…)
I BLOOM AT MY OWN SLOW RATE!

target.control_prompt:
[Verse 1]
It’s March 29, our Anniversary date
Dinner and a movie to help celebrate

[Verse 2]
Happy 23 years to my beautiful Bride
I can’t imagine you not by my side

[Verse 3]
The first time we met, it was quite an event
We had no idea our lives would change to this extent

[Verse 4]
The events we attended taught us both quite a lesson
God’s timing is perfect, He gave us both a blessing

[Verse 5]
The place where we met, neither was supposed to be
But God changed our schedules and said follow Me

[Verse 6]
He put us together in this fantastic place
And started us off, on this wonderful race

[Verse 7]
When we married in Galena, you were a beautiful Bride
Then both our lives changed, we were in for a ride

[Verse 8]
The chapel in Elizabeth was such a wonderful place
We walked the aisle slowly, then sang face to face

[Verse 9]
For many years we moved and our jobs did inspire
But the time finally came for us both to retire

[Verse 10]
Now I love our time together, we have a lot of fun
It’s been great and exciting, we’re always on the run

[Verse 11]
We travel the country and enjoy time at the lake
And all the sites we see as we drive from state to state

[Verse 12]
But here at home, it is the best of all
Hanging with our kids on the dock and watching them play ball

[Verse 13]
Your chair next to me is ready for you
Ready for our moments together, just us two

[Verse 14]
So sit back and relax, let the world fade away
I’m right here next to you, today and everyday

[Verse 15]
Can’t wait to hold you, right here by my side
With you forever, let’s enjoy this ride

[Verse 16]
We’ll laugh and dance, and let our spirits fly
Near or far Trish, you’re my favorite high

[Verse 17]
As I write this song for you, the thing that I’m expressing
All our thanks to God, for providing us this blessing

[Verse 18]
And I’ll never forget all the songs we sang, My Angel in the Night,
All our other favorites the songs were all just right

[Verse 19]
You are my love, yes the love of my life
And I’m so very happy to have you as my wife

[Verse 20]
I love you more now, more than ever before
And look forward to being with you more and more

[Verse 21]
So Happy Anniversary to you my true love
Let’s both offer thanks to our God up above

[Outro]
Thanks to our Father, for your love true and free
And we pray that you'll guide us through the next 23

target.control_prompt:
[Verse 1]
It’s March 29, our Anniversary date
Dinner and a movie to help celebrate

[Verse 2]
Happy 23 years to my beautiful Bride
I can’t imagine you not by my side

[Verse 3]
The first time we met, it was quite an event
We had no idea our lives would change to this extent

[Verse 4]
The events we attended taught us both quite a lesson
God’s timing is perfect, He gave us both a blessing

[Verse 5]
The place where we met, neither was supposed to be
But God changed our schedules and said follow Me

[Verse 6]
He put us together in this fantastic place
And started us off, on this wonderful race

[Verse 7]
When we married in Galena, you were a beautiful Bride
Then both our lives changed, we were in for a ride

[Verse 8]
The chapel in Elizabeth was such a wonderful place
We walked the aisle slowly, then sang face to face

[Verse 9]
For many years we moved and our jobs did inspire
But the time finally came for us both to retire

[Verse 10]
Now I love our time together, we have a lot of fun
It’s been great and exciting, we’re always on the run

[Verse 11]
We travel the country and enjoy time at the lake
And all the sites we see as we drive from state to state

[Verse 12]
But here at home, it is the best of all
Hanging with our kids on the dock and watching them play ball

[Verse 13]
Your chair next to me is ready for you
Ready for our moments together, just us two

[Verse 14]
So sit back and relax, let the world fade away
I’m right here next to you, today and everyday

[Verse 15]
Can’t wait to hold you, right here by my side
With you forever, let’s enjoy this ride

[Verse 16]
We’ll laugh and dance, and let our spirits fly
Near or far Trish, you’re my favorite high

[Verse 17]
As I write this song for you, the thing that I’m expressing
All our thanks to God, for providing us this blessing

[Verse 18]
And I’ll never forget all the songs we sang, My Angel in the Night,
All our other favorites the songs were all just right

[Verse 19]
You are my love, yes the love of my life
And I’m so very happy to have you as my wife

[Verse 20]
I love you more now, more than ever before
And look forward to being with you more and more

[Verse 21]
So Happy Anniversary to you my true love
Let’s both offer thanks to our God up above

[Outro]
Thanks to our Father, for your love true and free
And we pray that you'll guide us through the next 23

target.control_prompt:
🎵 “Let’s Learn Our Shapes!” 🎵
(Upbeat, playful, preschool-friendly)

Verse 1
Look around, what do you see?
Shapes are everywhere with you and me!
On the floor and in the sky,
Let’s find shapes—come on, let’s try!

Chorus
Circle, circle, round and round 🔵
Rolling, spinning on the ground!
Square, square, four sides straight ⬛
Triangle has three—count them, great! 🔺
Rectangle, oval, diamond too,
Learning shapes is fun to do!

Verse 2
A circle like the sun so bright ☀️
A square like a box just right 📦
A triangle like a slice of pie 🥧
A rectangle tall or wide!

Chorus
Circle, circle, round and round 🔵
Rolling, spinning on the ground!
Square, square, four sides straight ⬛
Triangle has three—count them, great! 🔺
Rectangle, oval, diamond too,
Learning shapes is fun to do!

Bridge
Clap your hands if you see a square! 👏
Spin around—circle’s everywhere!
Stomp your feet for triangle time!
Shapes, shapes—learning feels sublime!

Verse 3
Oval eggs and hearts so sweet 💛
Diamonds sparkle, oh so neat 💎
Big or small, short or tall,
Shapes are fun—let’s name them all!

Final Chorus
Circle, square, triangle—yay!
We know our shapes—hip hip hooray! 🎉
Rectangle, oval, diamond too,
Great job, friends—we learned with you!

🎵 End with claps and cheers! 🎵👏👏👏

[Instrumental Intro]

[Verse]
There’s a streetlight hummin’ down the shadowed lane,
Where the silver tongues are whisperin’ gain and pain.
The cards are dealt, but the dealer’s blind —
Still the truth walks steady, not fallin’ behind.

[Pre-Chorus]
They sell the shine, but it fades so fast,
All that glitter’s just smoke and glass.
But I heard a trumpet sound from afar —
It said, “Be holy where the sinners are.”

[Chorus]
His light don’t close at midnight,
Grace don’t fade with time.
Though the world may spin in false delight,
I’ll keep my soul in line.

[Chorus]
I’ll wear my armor, not my pride,
In this city of fools and gold.
His light don’t close at midnight —
His fire never grows cold.
[Solo]

[Verse]
There’s a lady singin’ sweet deceit,
Dressed in charm but chained at her feet.
Her melody’s soft, her promise fine,
But her cup runs over with bitter wine.

[Pre-Chorus]
So I fix my eyes on higher ground,
Where mercy flows, where truth is found.
The narrow road ain’t paved with fame,
But it’s marked by a holy Name.

[Chorus]
His light don’t close at midnight,
Grace don’t fade with time.
Though the crowd may dance in borrowed light,
I’ll walk the narrow way

[Chorus]
I’ll guard my heart where thieves abound,
Till the trumpet’s call I hear.
His light don’t close at midnight —
The Lamb of God draws near.
[Solo]

Let Babylon roar with all her lies —
The King still reigns above the skies.
[Solo]

[Chorus]

Grace don’t fade with time.

I’ll walk the narrow way

[Chorus]

The Lamb of God draws near.

target.control_prompt:
[Intro: Sparse metallic pulses, deep sub-bass drone, distant string swells]

[Verse 1]
指尖触到雪的脊背
它在我掌心低语
说昨日的松林
已变成风的形状

[Pre-Chorus: Glitchy percussion enters, low cello tremolo]
冻土下有东西在翻身
不是鹿
不是狼
是我埋下的名字

[Chorus: Swelling cinematic strings, industrial beat drops, layered vocals with wide reverb]
冰在呼吸！
山在后退！
我的脚印被光吃掉
却找不到归途的灰

[Verse 2]
鹰的影子掠过岩壁
像一道未愈合的缝
我数着空弹壳
它们比年岁更沉

[Pre-Chorus: Metallic textures intensify, breath-like sub-bass pulses]
冻土下有东西在翻身
不是火
不是歌
是我遗忘的回声

[Chorus: Full strings, distorted low-end thump, vocal eruption]
冰在呼吸！
山在后退！
我的脚印被光吃掉
却找不到归途的灰

[Bridge: Sudden silence, then sparse piano notes and vocal whispers]
(whispered, echoing)
雪落进眼睛
就变成海
我站在岸上
喊不出你的名字

[Chorus: Volcanic sub-bass returns, strings dissonant and soaring, vocals raw and layered]
冰在呼吸！
山在后退！
我的脚印被光吃掉
却找不到归途的灰

[Outro: Beat fades, strings dissolve into wind-like harmonics, voice fragments]
(softly, fragmented)
灰……
雪……
名字……
[ : Sub-bass fades, metallic pulses decay into silence]

asr_repeats.text: 时间走得觉得疲惫，它在我掌心低语。朔族人的森林已变成风的形状。冻土下不动心，在翻山不深入，不是浪，是晚霞的名字。兵在呼吸，山在后退。我的脚印被光吃掉，却找不到归途的灰。影的影子掠过眼底，像一道微弱的风。我数着空荡的堂壁念诵着。冻土下有东西在翻山不生火，不是歌，是我遗忘的火。兵在呼吸，山在后退。我的脚印被光吃掉，却找不到归途的灰。血和心眼心就变成爱。我站在岸上喊不出你的名字。兵在呼吸，山在后退。我的脚印被光吃掉，却找不到归途的灰。灰灰灰灰灰。

[Intro: Deep ambient synths with distant radio static, slow pipe organ swell]

[Verse 1]
南半球的夜没有边界
镜面转动，切开银河的薄雾
一个光点拒绝被命名
在双曲线轨道上写下告别

[Verse 2]
光谱里藏着陌生的绿
不是氰，不是尘，不是冰
是另一片星海的胎记
在日冕风里轻轻颤栗

[Pre-Chorus]
它不回头
也不回答
只把轨迹刻进虚空的账本

[Chorus]
你从银河之外来
带着未解的光尘
太阳系不过驿站
而你是永恒的过客
你向烈焰奔去
不为燃烧，只为证明
有些相遇
只为确认彼此的遥远

[Inst: Swelling strings, granular synth textures, low brass pulses]

[Verse 3]
木星在侧，地球屏息
计算它的速度与偏心
有人说是信使
有人说是种子
而它只是穿过
像风穿过空荡的门廊

[Bridge]
(whispered, echoing)
近日点不是终点
是它向宇宙递交的回执

[Chorus]
你从银河之外来
带着未解的光尘
太阳系不过驿站
而你是永恒的过客
你向烈焰奔去
不为燃烧，只为证明
有些相遇
只为确认彼此的遥远!

[Outro: Pipe organ fades into cosmic static, high metallic harmonics shimmer then vanish]
(softly, layered vocals)
飞吧……飞回你诞生的黑暗
我们曾见过你
这就够了

target.control_prompt:
[Verse 1]
A is for apple, juicy and red,
B is for balloon, floating overhead!
C is for cat, purring with delight,
D is for dog, barking in the night!

[Chorus]
Let's sing the alphabet, one letter at a time,
Boys and girls together, come join in our rhyme!
We’ll jump and we’ll dance as we learn, oh so fast,
With each little letter, we’ll have a blast!

[Verse 2]
E is for elephant, so big and so gray,
F is for fishy, swimming away!
G is for giraffe, with a neck so tall,
H is for hat, let’s wear one for all!

[Chorus2]
Let’s sing the alphabet, one letter at a time,
Boys and girls together, come join in our rhyme!
We’ll jump and we’ll dance as we learn, oh so fast,
With each little letter, we’ll have a blast!

[Verse 3]
I is for igloo, so chilly and nice,
J is for jellybeans, oh they’re so sweet and nice!
K is for kite, flying up in the sky,
L is for lion, hear him roar, oh my!

[Chorus3]
Let's sing the alphabet, one letter at a time,
Boys and girls together, come join in our rhyme!
We’ll jump and we’ll dance as we learn, oh so fast,
With each little letter, we’ll have a blast!

[Verse 4]
M is for monkey, swinging in the trees,
N is for nest, with birds and buzzing bees!
O is for octopus, swimming in the sea,
P is for puppy, oh so cuddly!

[Chorus4]
Let’s sing the alphabet, one letter at a time,
Boys and girls together, come join in our rhyme!
We’ll jump and we’ll dance as we learn, oh so fast,
With each little letter, we’ll have a blast!

[Verse 5]
Q is for queen, wearing her shiny crown,
R is for rainbow, shining all around!
S is for sun, brightening the day,
T is for turtle, moving slow, hooray!

[Chorus5]
Let's sing the alphabet, one letter at a time,
Boys and girls together, come join in our rhyme!
We’ll jump and we’ll dance as we learn,

[Verse 6]
U is for umbrella, when the rain starts to fall,
V is for volcano, rumbling, standing tall!
W is for whale, swimming in the deep,
X is for xylophone, music that’s sweet!

[Chorus6]
Let’s sing the alphabet, one letter at a time,
Boys and girls together, come join in our rhyme!
We’ll jump and we’ll dance as we learn, oh so fast,
With each little letter, we’ll have a blast!

[Bridge]
Y is for yellow, bright as the sun,
Z is for zebra, with stripes, oh what fun!
Now we’ve sung the alphabet, from A to Z,
Boys and girls together, we’ve learned, can’t you see?

[Outro]
Now that we know our A, B, C’s,
Learning can be fun with so much ease!
Let’s keep on singing, and play every day,
With our A, B, C Adventure, hip-hip-hooray!

[Verse 1]
A is for apple, juicy and red,
B is for balloon, floating overhead!
C is for cat, purring with delight,
D is for dog, barking in the night!

[Chorus]
Let's sing the alphabet, one letter at a time,
Boys and girls together, come join in our rhyme!
We’ll jump and we’ll dance as we learn, oh so fast,
With each little letter, we’ll have a blast!

[Verse 2]
E is for elephant, so big and so gray,
F is for fishy, swimming away!
G is for giraffe, with a neck so tall,
H is for hat, let’s wear one for all!

[Chorus2]
Let’s sing the alphabet, one letter at a time,
Boys and girls together, come join in our rhyme!
We’ll jump and we’ll dance as we learn, oh so fast,
With each little letter, we’ll have a blast!

[Verse 3]
I is for igloo, so chilly and nice,
J is for jellybeans, oh they’re so sweet and nice!
K is for kite, flying up in the sky,
L is for lion, hear him roar, oh my!

[Chorus3]
Let's sing the alphabet, one letter at a time,
Boys and girls together, come join in our rhyme!
We’ll jump and we’ll dance as we learn, oh so fast,
With each little letter, we’ll have a blast!

[Verse 4]
M is for monkey, swinging in the trees,
N is for nest, with birds and buzzing bees!
O is for octopus, swimming in the sea,
P is for puppy, oh so cuddly!

[Chorus4]
Let’s sing the alphabet, one letter at a time,
Boys and girls together, come join in our rhyme!
We’ll jump and we’ll dance as we learn, oh so fast,
With each little letter, we’ll have a blast!

[Verse 5]
Q is for queen, wearing her shiny crown,
R is for rainbow, shining all around!
S is for sun, brightening the day,
T is for turtle, moving slow, hooray!

[Chorus5]
Let's sing the alphabet, one letter at a time,
Boys and girls together, come join in our rhyme!
We’ll jump and we’ll dance as we learn,

[Verse 6]
U is for umbrella, when the rain starts to fall,
V is for volcano, rumbling, standing tall!
W is for whale, swimming in the deep,
X is for xylophone, music that’s sweet!

[Chorus6]
Let’s sing the alphabet, one letter at a time,
Boys and girls together, come join in our rhyme!
We’ll jump and we’ll dance as we learn, oh so fast,
With each little letter, we’ll have a blast!

[Bridge]
Y is for yellow, bright as the sun,
Z is for zebra, with stripes, oh what fun!
Now we’ve sung the alphabet, from A to Z,
Boys and girls together, we’ve learned, can’t you see?

[Outro]
Now that we know our A, B, C’s,
Learning can be fun with so much ease!
Let’s keep on singing, and play every day,
With our A, B, C Adventure, hip-hip-hooray!

target.tags_full:
STYLE: Dark, adult, minimal. Industrial techno + prog metal fused with tribal percussion and 50s jazz swing. Tense, awkward, human, controlled, subtle humor.

TEMPO: ~84 BPM. Constant sub + kick pulse. Verses swing, hooks snap to grid.

DRUMS: Deep techno kick, layered tribal toms, glitch trap hats in chaos, tight hats in control, micro dropouts for STOP moments.

MUSIC: Detuned upright piano with tape warmth in social sections. Fuzz bass pulses. Bassoons, low brass, horn stabs, timpani transitions. Brass sustains in control sections.

VOCALS: Close dry lead, wide gang chants, occasional vintage radio mic for adlibs and drop cues.

STRUCTURE: Internal intro → pull builds → heavy hook → social chaos → hard STOP cut → controlled groove → mirrored section → minimal resolution.

MOTIF: pull, signal shift, held tension, awkward release.

FEEL: tribal ritual meets club, chaotic but held. Symphonic drops with periodic 50s radio mic sound.

target.tags_full:
STYLE: Dark, adult, minimal. Industrial techno + prog metal fused with tribal percussion and 50s jazz swing. Tense, awkward, human, controlled, subtle humor.

TEMPO: ~84 BPM. Constant sub + kick pulse. Verses swing, hooks snap to grid.

DRUMS: Deep techno kick, layered tribal toms, glitch trap hats in chaos, tight hats in control, micro dropouts for STOP moments.

MUSIC: Detuned upright piano with tape warmth in social sections. Fuzz bass pulses. Bassoons, low brass, horn stabs, timpani transitions. Brass sustains in control sections.

VOCALS: Close dry lead, wide gang chants, occasional vintage radio mic for adlibs and drop cues.

STRUCTURE: Internal intro → pull builds → heavy hook → social chaos → hard STOP cut → controlled groove → mirrored section → minimal resolution.

MOTIF: pull, signal shift, held tension, awkward release.

FEEL: tribal ritual meets club, chaotic but held. Symphonic drops with periodic 50s radio mic sound.

Follow me, your majesty.

[Chorus]

Chase your lips, pull you in

So suddenly seein’ your face now glowin'

Mmmm-hmmm-hmmm
There’s danger ahead, can’t see where I’m goin’

Was once on top, king o' the town,

Distracting smile, you took my crown,

[Verse 3]

Skin on skin, at Golden Inn

Your magic move, I've fallen hard,
Grand-master beat, a perfect scorecard

[Chorus]
Here I go, yeah, once again

Chase your lips, pull you in
Here I go, now, once again, hmmm

Here I go, yeah, once again (I'm seeing you)

Here I go, now, once again (uh-hah)
Here I go, yeah queen caught a king.
target.tags_full:
Dance-pop track blending electronic production with contemporary R&B. Song flow unfolds in standard pop-EDM structure, 116 BPM in F minor.
Verse 1 builds over sparse beats, leading to pre-chorus swell of layered harmonies & vocoder effects. Fragmented chorus/drop erupts with frantic electronic pulses and retro disco-funk grooves, repeating the hook. 
Song culminates in an anthemic outro that loops.
Instrumentation fuses EDM with nostalgic warmth of pulsating synth bass & frantic hi-hats to drive the drop, while dreamy pads & electric guitar-like synths add shimmer. Subtle piano anchors verses. Vocoder processes vocals for a robotic, echoing quality in chorus. Funky basslines & retro disco stabs inject groove.
Mezzo-soprano vocals shine with raw, soulful introspection — husky and breathy in verses, soaring to emotive belts in choruses with subtle cracks to convey heartbreak. Vocals span F3 to D♭5 & layers harmonies., male vocals

target.tags_full:
Dance-pop track blending electronic production with contemporary R&B. Song flow unfolds in standard pop-EDM structure, 116 BPM in F minor.
Verse 1 builds over sparse beats, leading to pre-chorus swell of layered harmonies & vocoder effects. Fragmented chorus/drop erupts with frantic electronic pulses and retro disco-funk grooves, repeating the hook. 
Song culminates in an anthemic outro that loops.
Instrumentation fuses EDM with nostalgic warmth of pulsating synth bass & frantic hi-hats to drive the drop, while dreamy pads & electric guitar-like synths add shimmer. Subtle piano anchors verses. Vocoder processes vocals for a robotic, echoing quality in chorus. Funky basslines & retro disco stabs inject groove.
Mezzo-soprano vocals shine with raw, soulful introspection — husky and breathy in verses, soaring to emotive belts in choruses with subtle cracks to convey heartbreak. Vocals span F3 to D♭5 & layers harmonies., male vocals

target.control_prompt:
[Intro: Muted piano with brushed snare and warm double bass]

[Verse 1]
咖啡渍在处方笺上开花
我给它添了眼睛和酒窝
医生问最近睡得怎样
我说梦里总在整理旧袜子
一只只配对 从不丢失

[Verse 2]
维生素瓶里装着蓝色小月亮
每天吞两粒 假装是补钙
朋友夸我气色不错
我点头 笑出标准弧度
连嘴角上扬都卡在安全线内

[Pre-Chorus]
我把崩溃调成静音模式
像冰箱冷藏室的嗡鸣
你递来热汤
我道谢时
顺手把眼泪折进餐巾纸角落

[Chorus]
我没事，真的没事
只是偶尔和影子吵到凌晨三点
你说这算不算一种天赋
能把深渊说得像
周末郊游的野餐垫

[Inst: Piano solo with walking bass and soft cymbal swell]

[Verse 3]
日历撕到第十七张
雨没停 心跳却开始跳拍
我把“求救”写成购物清单
夹在牛奶和吐司之间
假装生活只是轻微失调

[Pre-Chorus]
我把沉默谱成摇篮曲
哄自己相信明天会准时醒来
你挥手说晚安
而我数着药片
等它们哪天替我开口

[Chorus]
我没事，真的没事
只是偶尔和影子吵到凌晨三点
你说这算不算一种天赋
能把深渊说得像
周末郊游的野餐垫

[Bridge]
(whispered)
其实我早该撕掉这剧本
我不是乐观
只是怕你皱眉
那副完美病人面具下
连呼吸都算计着分贝

[Chorus]
我没事，真的没事
连崩溃都学会用微笑打包寄走
你说这算不算一种病
明明快散成灰
还要说“别担心，我很好”!

[Outro: Piano fades with double bass walking down, distant cymbal shimmer]
……很好。
（spoken, fading）
骗你的。

target.control_prompt:
[Intro: Sub-bass pulse, glassy string harmonics, faint clockwork ticking]

[Verse 1]
镜面斜切月光 像碎掉的银箔
她后退三步 踩碎自己倒影的轮廓
高跟鞋尖点地 裙摆卷起漩涡
南瓜香混着铁锈 在鼻尖轻轻灼

[Pre-Chorus: Metallic finger snaps, vinyl hiss rising]
镜中手突然攥紧 她腕骨发烫
倒数第二秒——

[Chorus: Cold strings surge, bass distorts, vocal pierces]
转！碎！镜中千个我！
假面在反光里自燃成火！
南瓜香裹着铁锈灌进肺窝
幽灵踮脚踩碎所有退路！
DANCE TILL YOU BREAK!

[Verse 2]
追兵撞进镜廊 被自己吓退三丈
她摘下发簪 划开雾气写一行方向
糖霜蛛网垂落 缠住喘息的谎
汽笛从地底升起 轨道在镜后回响

[Pre-Chorus: Ticking accelerates, glass shatter stabs]
镜缝渗出红光 照见刀尖微晃——

[Chorus: Layered shrieking harmonies, frenetic pizzicato]
转！碎！镜中千个我！
假面在反光里自燃成火！
南瓜香裹着铁锈灌进肺窝
幽灵踮脚踩碎所有退路！
DANCE TILL YOU BREAK!

[Bridge: Sudden stop, solo cello tremolo, lo-fi static]
(whispered)
怕我？还是怕镜中那个你？
(shouted)
那就把整面墙烧成糖衣！

[Chorus: Full chaos—metallic crashes, distorted strings, vocal at breaking point]
转！碎！镜中千个我！
假面在反光里自燃成火！
南瓜香裹着铁锈灌进肺窝
幽灵踮脚踩碎所有退路！
DANCE TILL YOU BREAK!

[Outro: Distorted music box melody, candle snuff, echoing giggle]
(whispered, fading)
下一镜……敢不敢照自己？

target.control_prompt:
[Intro: Rain falling on glass, slow jazz piano with low cello drones, faint electronic hum]

[Verse 1: Baritone, spoken word over sparse piano]
我是布雷克。
两点零七分，屏幕的光割开黑暗，
雨砸在窗上，像有人轻轻叩问。
风衣吸饱了水汽，咖啡凉透，
C市的街灯在积水里拉长，空得发慌。

[Verse 2: Tenor, melodic recitation, cello enters softly]
马修蜷在转椅里，
手指敲着键盘，节奏故作轻松。
鞋底的泥还没干，碎发贴着额角，
嘴角那点笑，藏不住眼里的光。

[Verse 3: Baritone, half-spoken, piano pauses on dissonant chord]
圣侣被盗——两座金童，
指纹干净得像从未被人碰过。
碎玻璃铺满展厅，
监控却在那一刻，集体失语。

[Verse 4: Tenor, slightly faster, electronic pulse faintly rises]
（spoken, tapping empty cup）
也许他们是米达斯王的私生子，
赶着回黄金宫殿过节呢？
（笑声轻，却没传到眼睛）

[Verse 5: Baritone, lower, breath held]
我想到女儿——她总在圣侣前驻足。
也转发过你的照片，说：
“这才是探员该有的样子。”
可现在，空气重得压住所有玩笑。

[Inst: Piano arpeggio slows, cello sustains low note, rain intensifies]

[Verse 6: Baritone and Tenor, alternating lines, overlapping slightly]
（Baritone）
偷盗集团？为何只取圣侣？
（Tenor）
内部人？可指纹为何消失？
（Baritone）
技术故障？偏偏只在那三小时？
（Tenor）
超自然？……不，不该想这个。

[Bridge: Both voices, whispered in unison, then diverge]
（whispered）
有什么不对……
（Baritone, strained）
不是幻觉……
（Tenor, faltering）
是预感……

[Verse 7: Baritone, spoken, piano stops]
屏幕闪了三下——
然后，全黑。

[Outro: Rain continues, single piano note repeats, cello fades, electronic hum dissolves into silence]
（spoken, barely audible）
只有雨……
和一座湿透的城市。

（rain falling, then silence）

asr_repeats.text: 我是布雷克，懒得零气氛。屏幕的光隔开黑暗，雨砸在窗上，像有人轻轻靠我。风一吸饱了水汽，咖啡凉透。稀疏的街灯在汽水里拉长，空得发慌。马修站在窗里，里手指敲着键盘，节奏故作轻松。鞋底的泥还没干，碎发贴着额角，嘴角那点笑，藏不住眼里的光。森林被刀，两座尽头，枝落干净得像从未被人碰过。碎玻璃铺满展厅，监控却在那一刻集体失语。也许他们是米达斯王的私生子，看着灰黄天空的国界。我想丹尼尔，他总在梦里牵住我，也转发过你的照片，说这才是太原该有的样子。可现在，恐惧中压住所有欢笑。偷盗集团，为何只取三轮？内部人，可只问为何消失？技术故障，偏偏只在那三小时。超自然，不该想着。有什么不对？不是幻觉，是雨感。屏幕闪了三下，然后全黑，只有雨和一座湿透的城市。

target.control_prompt:
[Intro: Rain falling on glass, slow jazz piano with low cello drones, faint electronic hum]

[Verse 1: Baritone, spoken word over sparse piano]
我是布雷克。
两点零七分，屏幕的光割开黑暗，
雨砸在窗上，像有人轻轻叩问。
风衣吸饱了水汽，咖啡凉透，
C市的街灯在积水里拉长，空得发慌。

[Verse 2: Tenor, melodic recitation, cello enters softly]
马修蜷在转椅里，
手指敲着键盘，节奏故作轻松。
鞋底的泥还没干，碎发贴着额角，
嘴角那点笑，藏不住眼里的光。

[Verse 3: Baritone, half-spoken, piano pauses on dissonant chord]
圣侣被盗——两座金童，
指纹干净得像从未被人碰过。
碎玻璃铺满展厅，
监控却在那一刻，集体失语。

[Verse 4: Tenor, slightly faster, electronic pulse faintly rises]
（spoken, tapping empty cup）
也许他们是米达斯王的私生子，
赶着回黄金宫殿过节呢？
（笑声轻，却没传到眼睛）

[Verse 5: Baritone, lower, breath held]
我想到女儿——她总在圣侣前驻足。
也转发过你的照片，说：
“这才是探员该有的样子。”
可现在，空气重得压住所有玩笑。

[Inst: Piano arpeggio slows, cello sustains low note, rain intensifies]

[Verse 6: Baritone and Tenor, alternating lines, overlapping slightly]
（Baritone）
偷盗集团？为何只取圣侣？
（Tenor）
内部人？可指纹为何消失？
（Baritone）
技术故障？偏偏只在那三小时？
（Tenor）
超自然？……不，不该想这个。

[Bridge: Both voices, whispered in unison, then diverge]
（whispered）
有什么不对……
（Baritone, strained）
不是幻觉……
（Tenor, faltering）
是预感……

[Verse 7: Baritone, spoken, piano stops]
屏幕闪了三下——
然后，全黑。

[Outro: Rain continues, single piano note repeats, cello fades, electronic hum dissolves into silence]
（spoken, barely audible）
只有雨……
和一座湿透的城市。

（rain falling, then silence）

target.tags_full: A high-energy rock track with a driving rhythm section, featuring a male lead vocalist and backing vocals. The song is in a major key, with a fast tempo. The instrumentation includes electric guitars, bass guitar, and drums. The electric guitars provide both rhythmic chugging and melodic lead lines, often with a distorted tone. The bass guitar lays down a solid, driving foundation. The drums feature a prominent kick and snare, with frequent cymbal crashes. The lead male vocalist sings with a clear, powerful voice, often in a slightly higher register, and is occasionally joined by harmonized backing vocals. The song structure includes verses, pre-choruses, and choruses, with a distinct instrumental break featuring a guitar solo. Production elements include a tight mix with a strong emphasis on the drums and lead vocals, and a moderate amount of reverb on the vocals and guitars.

asr_repeats.text: 本来应该从从容容，悠然悠语。现在是匆匆忙忙，连滚带爬。睁眼说梦话，你在哽咽什么啦？你在哭什么哭没出息？镜子中的人眼里生了锈迹。脸上的生气将细微纹布带刺。你是谁的儿女？谁是你的子鼠之己？白首风雨俱与你同行。时光中的人像流离离去。枯黄的叶片披着满地的诗意。谁是你的同情？你是谁的子鼠之己？白首万金不必不语。本来应该从从容容，悠然悠语。现在是匆匆忙忙，连滚带爬。睁眼说梦话，喊到喉咙都沙哑。听不见的回答没出息。但是向往天空想成为龙马龙，飞起来向着风去远方梦啊梦。外面的雾太重，迷了眼瞳啊瞳，内心的火种快熄灭在世界的迷宫。想因为感情痛却忘了加层棉，为你留了一枕头一直在等啊等。就算再认真的你，也可以再次触碰。荆棘的你的痛痛里触碰一片心。本来应该从从容容，悠然悠语。现在是匆匆忙忙，连滚带爬。睁眼说梦话，喊到喉咙都沙哑。听不见的回答没出息。本来应该从从容容，悠然悠语。现在是匆匆忙忙，连滚带爬。睁眼说梦话，你在哽咽什么啦？你在哭什么哭没出息？哭着说傻话，直到人生已沙哑。自问自答一句有出息。

target.tags_full: A high-energy rock track with a driving rhythm section, featuring a male lead vocalist and backing vocals. The song is in a major key, with a fast tempo. The instrumentation includes electric guitars, bass guitar, and drums. The electric guitars provide both rhythmic chugging and melodic lead lines, often with a distorted tone. The bass guitar lays down a solid, driving foundation. The drums feature a prominent kick and snare, with frequent cymbal crashes. The lead male vocalist sings with a clear, powerful voice, often in a slightly higher register, and is occasionally joined by harmonized backing vocals. The song structure includes verses, pre-choruses, and choruses, with a distinct instrumental break featuring a guitar solo. Production elements include a tight mix with a strong emphasis on the drums and lead vocals, and a moderate amount of reverb on the vocals and guitars.

target.tags_full: A high-energy Chinese pop song with a driving beat and a blend of traditional and modern instrumentation. The song is in a major key, with a fast tempo. The primary instruments include a drum kit providing a steady pop rhythm, a prominent bass guitar laying down a groovy foundation, and a keyboard or synthesizer playing melodic lines and chord progressions. There are also string-like synth pads that add a lush texture. The lead female vocalist sings with a clear, bright tone, often employing a slightly breathy quality. The song features a clear verse-chorus structure, with a pre-chorus that builds anticipation. Production elements include a clean mix with a good balance between instruments and vocals, and some reverb on the vocals to give them a sense of space. The melody is catchy and memorable, with a strong emphasis on rhythmic delivery in the verses and a more soaring quality in the chorus. There are occasional vocal ad-libs that add to the playful and energetic feel.

target.tags_full: A high-energy Chinese pop song with a driving beat and a blend of traditional and modern instrumentation. The song is in a major key, with a fast tempo. The primary instruments include a drum kit providing a steady pop rhythm, a prominent bass guitar laying down a groovy foundation, and a keyboard or synthesizer playing melodic lines and chord progressions. There are also string-like synth pads that add a lush texture. The lead female vocalist sings with a clear, bright tone, often employing a slightly breathy quality. The song features a clear verse-chorus structure, with a pre-chorus that builds anticipation. Production elements include a clean mix with a good balance between instruments and vocals, and some reverb on the vocals to give them a sense of space. The melody is catchy and memorable, with a strong emphasis on rhythmic delivery in the verses and a more soaring quality in the chorus. There are occasional vocal ad-libs that add to the playful and energetic feel.

[instrumental intro]
(钢琴)

[Verse 1]
曾经站在  红榜砌成的神坛
仰望我的  是无数期待的眼
直到那天  我听见低语在蔓延
它问天平另一端  是否存在  另一片天
[Verse 2]
于是我走下  阶梯假装是意外 
踏入所谓  真实存在的平凡 
在及格线  画上我安全的港湾 
浑浑噩噩的十年  像部默剧  无声上演 
[Chorus]
天赋它弃我而去  如流沙散 
我守着废墟  把昨天悼念 
酸苦辣都尝遍  唯独没有甜 
在清醒中  我把自己流放边关 
[Chorus]
这十年之蜕  痛彻心扉 
撕掉标签  看清我是谁 
告别那场  自导自演的坠毁 
与平凡的自己  干杯  致敬这狼狈 
敬我曾头也不回！ 
[Interlude]
(钢琴)

[Verse 3]
也曾在招聘会  像沙丁鱼搁浅 
简历苍白如纸  写满我的无言 
挤在格子间  把梦想碾成碎片 
看霓虹点亮黑夜  照不亮我  内心的深渊 
[Chorus]
直到某个寒冬  便利店窗边 
我看见倒影里  陌生憔悴的脸 
那虚无的尽头  传来一声响鞭 
问我还想不想  找回失落的碎片 
[Chorus]
这十年之蜕  痛彻心扉 
撕掉标签  看清我是谁 
告别那场  自导自演的坠毁 
与平凡的自己  干杯  致敬这狼狈 
敬我曾头也不回！ 
[Bridge]
堕落与智慧  都是我  一体两面 
这场漫长战争  是自我的加冕 
不再问对错  不再分辨鬼与神 
我就是我  废墟里  重生的普通人 
[Chorus]
这十年之蜕  落子无悔！ 
拥抱残缺  完整的才是美 
未来如旷野  风向由我心支配 
与真实的自己  干杯  致敬所有泪 
敬我 终将高飞！
[Outro]
(钢琴)

[End]

target.control_prompt:
[instrumental intro]
(钢琴)

[Verse 1]
曾经站在  红榜砌成的神坛
仰望我的  是无数期待的眼
直到那天  我听见低语在蔓延
它问天平另一端  是否存在  另一片天
[Verse 2]
于是我走下  阶梯假装是意外 
踏入所谓  真实存在的平凡 
在及格线  画上我安全的港湾 
浑浑噩噩的十年  像部默剧  无声上演 
[Chorus]
天赋它弃我而去  如流沙散 
我守着废墟  把昨天悼念 
酸苦辣都尝遍  唯独没有甜 
在清醒中  我把自己流放边关 
[Chorus]
这十年之蜕  痛彻心扉 
撕掉标签  看清我是谁 
告别那场  自导自演的坠毁 
与平凡的自己  干杯  致敬这狼狈 
敬我曾头也不回！ 
[Interlude]
(钢琴)

[Verse 3]
也曾在招聘会  像沙丁鱼搁浅 
简历苍白如纸  写满我的无言 
挤在格子间  把梦想碾成碎片 
看霓虹点亮黑夜  照不亮我  内心的深渊 
[Chorus]
直到某个寒冬  便利店窗边 
我看见倒影里  陌生憔悴的脸 
那虚无的尽头  传来一声响鞭 
问我还想不想  找回失落的碎片 
[Chorus]
这十年之蜕  痛彻心扉 
撕掉标签  看清我是谁 
告别那场  自导自演的坠毁 
与平凡的自己  干杯  致敬这狼狈 
敬我曾头也不回！ 
[Bridge]
堕落与智慧  都是我  一体两面 
这场漫长战争  是自我的加冕 
不再问对错  不再分辨鬼与神 
我就是我  废墟里  重生的普通人 
[Chorus]
这十年之蜕  落子无悔！ 
拥抱残缺  完整的才是美 
未来如旷野  风向由我心支配 
与真实的自己  干杯  致敬所有泪 
敬我 终将高飞！
[Outro]
(钢琴)

[End]

target.tags_full: A dance-pop track with a tempo of 120 BPM in the key of C minor. The instrumentation includes a prominent synth bass line, a four-on-the-floor kick drum, a snare drum with a short reverb, and closed hi-hats providing a consistent eighth-note rhythm. Synthesizer pads provide harmonic support, and a plucked synth melody plays a counterpoint to the main vocal. The male lead vocal is clean and centrally panned, with a moderate amount of reverb. A female backing vocal provides harmonies during the chorus sections. The song structure follows a typical verse-chorus format with an instrumental intro and outro. The melody is largely diatonic, emphasizing the minor key. Production elements include sidechain compression on the synth pads, creating a pumping effect in time with the kick drum.

The instrumentation includes a prominent synth bass line, a four-on-the-floor kick drum, a snare drum with a short reverb, and closed hi-hats providing a consistent eighth-note rhythm. Synthesizer pads provide harmonic support, and a plucked synth melody plays a counterpoint to the main vocal. The male lead vocal is clean and centrally panned, with a moderate amount of reverb. A female backing vocal provides harmonies during the chorus sections. The song structure follows a typical verse-chorus format with an instrumental intro and outro. The melody is largely diatonic, emphasizing the minor key. Production elements include sidechain compression on the synth pads, creating a pumping effect in time with the kick drum.

[Verse 1: Male]
冰箱还开着缝 / 你摔门没关严
茶几上两杯凉透的水 / 谁都没碰第三遍
你说我总在逃避 / 可话到嘴边又变轻
像那盏忽明忽暗的灯 / 照不亮你眼里的冷

[Hook: Female]
为什么不哄我？
就一句软话都吝啬？
我站在雨里等伞 / 你却在屋檐下数裂痕
为什么不哄我？
连沉默都带着刺
你给的安静 / 比争吵更伤人

[Verse 2: Female]
你总说‘冷静一下’ / 像按下暂停键
可情绪不是录像带 / 能倒回重演
我翻你手机不是疑心 / 是怕你连敷衍都懒得演
你低头系鞋带的样子 / 像在系紧自己的防线

[Hook: Male & Female]
(whispered, layered vocals)
为什么不哄我？
……我其实想抱你
可手停在半空 / 怕你推开更彻底
为什么不哄我？
……我怕越哄越错
于是我们各自困在 / 同一个房间的两个角落

[Verse 3: Male]
你睫毛沾着泪 / 却不肯低头
我数你呼吸的节奏 / 像数错过的所有温柔
不是不想认错 / 是怕认了就代表我全错
可你的背影说：你连错在哪都不知道

[Hook: Female]
为什么不哄我？
连假装都不会
你给的安全感 / 薄得像张过期车票
为什么不哄我？
连痛都懒得吵
我们用最熟的语气 / 说着最生疏的台词

[Bridge: Both, half-sung with reverb]
(soft 808 pulse underneath)
其实……
只要你说一句‘别走’
我就留下
其实……
只要你伸手
我就回头

[Outro: Female, fading with vinyl crackle]
……你还是没哄我
(heartbeat fades)

竟是你的轮廓

用沉默焊接最后一句挽留

黑白默片循环在 没有出口的镜头

[End]

target.control_prompt:
在时光长河静静流淌的角落
有两双眼睛 闪烁着爱的火
那是父母 用一生把我雕琢
岁月在他们脸上 刻下了斑驳

小时候 我在他们怀里安卧
听着温暖的歌谣 做着甜的梦
他们为我挡下 所有的风波
把我护在 这小小的安乐窝

当我背起行囊 勇敢去漂泊
他们的牵挂 像风筝的线索
电话里的叮嘱 满是关切的热
每一句话语 都让我心热

父亲的背 曾经是那么宽阔
扛起了家庭 扛起了生活的负荷
如今有些弯曲 却依然是依托
我多想 为他分担这岁月的磨

母亲的手 总是那么的柔和
为我缝补着 生活里的褶皱
那掌心的茧 是爱的成就
我好想 把她的辛苦都带走

感恩父母情 像一首永恒的歌
旋律里都是 他们无私的付出
感恩父母情 像夜空中的星河
照亮我前行 每一步的路

还记得 那些一起的欢乐时刻
一家人围坐 分享着生活的喜乐
父母的笑容 是最美的花朵
绽放在我 生命的每个角落

成长的路上 有过太多的波折
是他们的鼓励 让我重新振作
在我迷茫时 为我点亮灯火
指引我 走向光明的那方坡

感恩父母情 像一杯醇厚的酒
越品越香浓 醉了我的心窝
感恩父母情 像春天的花朵
芬芳了我 整个生命的轮廓

我知道 他们的爱不会有尽头
就像那青山 永远不会变瘦
我愿用一生 去把这份爱守
让他们的晚年 不再有忧愁

在未来的日子 我会紧紧牵着
他们的手 陪他们慢慢的走
把所有的爱 都为他们倾注
让感恩的花 永远不会凋落

因为有他们 我才如此的富有
拥有这世上 最珍贵的所有
感恩父母情 永在我心中留
这份深情 直到天长地久

asr_repeats.text: 在时光长河静静流淌的脚，有两双眼睛闪烁着爱的火。那是父母用一生把我雕琢，岁月在他们脸上刻下了斑驳。小时候我在他们怀里安卧，听着温暖的歌谣做着甜的梦。他们为我挡下所有的风波，保护在这小小的安了我。当我被惊醒了勇敢去漂泊，他们的牵挂像风筝的线索。电话里的叮咛满是关切的热，每一句话语都让我心热。父亲的背曾经是那么宽阔，扛起了家庭扛起了生活的负荷。如今有些弯曲却依然是一坨，我多想为他分担这岁月的磨。母亲的手总是那么的柔和，为我缝补着生活里的褶皱。那矫情的坚持爱的长久，我好想把他的辛苦都带走。感恩父母亲像一首永恒的歌，旋律里都是他们无私的付出。感恩父母亲像夜空中的星河，照亮我前行每一步的路。还记得那些一起的欢乐时刻，一家人围坐分享着生活的喜乐，父母的笑容是最美的花朵，绽放在我生命的每个角落。成长的路上有过太多的波折，是他们的鼓励让我重新振作。在我迷茫时为我点亮的火，指引我走向光明的那方坡。感恩父母亲像一杯醇厚的酒，越品越香浓醉了我的心窝。感恩父母亲像春天的花朵，芬芳了我整个生命的轮廓。我知道他们的爱不会有尽头，就像那青山永远不会变瘦。我愿用一生去把这份爱守，让他们都万年不再有忧愁。在未来的日子会静静牵着，他们的手陪他们慢慢的走，把所有的爱都为他们倾注，让爱的花永远不会凋落。因为有他们我才如此的富有，拥有这世上最珍贵的所有。感恩父母亲永在我心中留，这份深情直到天长地久。

asr_repeats.text: 在时光长河静静流淌的角落，有两双眼睛闪烁着爱的火。那是父母用一生把我雕琢，岁月在他们脸上刻下了斑驳。小时候我在他们怀里安卧，听着温暖的歌谣做着甜的梦。他们为我挡下所有的风波，把我护在这小小的安乐窝。当我背起行囊勇敢去漂泊，他们的牵挂像风筝的线索，电话里的叮咛满是关切的热。每一句话语都让我心热。父亲的背曾经是那么宽阔，扛起了家庭扛起了生活的负荷。如今有些委屈却依然是依托。我多想为他分担这岁月的磨。母亲的手总是那么的柔和，为我缝补着生活里的褶皱。那掌心的茧是爱的成就。我好想把他的辛苦都带走。感恩父母亲像一首永恒的歌，旋律里都是他们无私的付出。感恩父母亲像夜空中的星河，照亮我前行每一步的路。还记得那亲情的欢乐时刻，一家人为做分享着生活的喜乐。父母的笑容是最美的花朵，绽放在我生命的每个角落。成长的路上有过太多的波折，是他们的鼓励让我重新做。在我迷茫时为我点亮灯火，指引我走向光明的那方坡。感恩父母亲像一杯醇厚的酒，越品越香浓醉了我的心窝。感恩父母亲像春天的花朵，芬芳了我整个生命的轮廓。我知道他们的爱不会有尽头，就像那青山永远不会变瘦。我愿用一生去把这份爱说，让他们的晚年不再有忧愁。在未来的日子我会紧紧牵着，他们的手陪他们慢慢的走，把所有的爱都为他们倾注，让感恩的话永远不会凋落。因为有他们我才如此的富有，拥有这世上最珍贵的所有。感恩父母亲永在我心中留，这份深情直到天长地久。

You only try to quiet your noise, you only want to know. If your fire isn't meant to fade or glow, and so you ask the one question, the one I always seem to hear, only one few single words that broke my glass and burned our place. I did not ask for this, just wanted you to be my friend.

target.control_prompt:
在时光长河悠悠流淌之处
有一座回忆的碑 立在我心谷
那是您 我的师父
用智慧与温柔 把岁月雕塑

还记得初见您的模样
眼神如星芒 照亮我迷茫
您的话语似春风轻拂
带我走进艺术神秘的殿堂

您手把手教我技艺的每一环
每一个动作都充满温暖
耐心纠正我每一处的偏差
让我在成长路上不再惧怕

课堂上您的讲解如诗如画
把知识化作灵动的火花
那一字一句的谆谆教诲
似清泉在我心田静静洒下

您带着我领略艺术的巅峰
让我看到世界别样的恢宏
在每一个难题面前
您是我最坚实的支撑

可如今 那熟悉的身影已远走
只剩回忆在心底不停游走
我在这寂静的夜里回首
泪水模糊了往昔的所有

我抚摸着您曾用过的物件
仿佛还能感受到您的温度
那温暖的气息未曾消散
依旧围绕在我的身边

我站在曾经学艺的老地方
看着那斑驳的墙壁和旧时光
仿佛还能听见您的笑声
在这空旷的空间里回荡

我多想再听您一次教导
多想再感受您的微笑
可时光它匆匆不肯停留
只留下这无尽的哀愁

在这漫长的岁月里
我带着您的期望独自前行
每一步都带着您的印记
每一刻都把您深深铭记

您是我艺术之路的启明星
是我生命中最亮的风景
即使您已不在我的身旁
您的精神永远在我心中闪亮

我会带着您的梦想去飞翔
让您的名字在艺术中传扬
在未来的每一个日子里
永远把您的恩情歌唱

target.control_prompt:
Verse 1
以热爱为纸 铺站成信仰
以理想为笔 挥洒出篇章
当足音回响 在合和圣第
便写下故事 名叫做美迹

Pre-Chorus 1
曾在质疑中 将根劲深埋
曾在风浪里 把梦想承载
穿越了岁月 荒原与荆棘
守护着心中 不灭的微光

Chorus 1
让信念化作 那漫天星光
照亮这土地 深沉的渴望
让热忱燃成 不灭的火焰
在风雨之中 骄傲的意立

Verse 2
这些年我们 如追光青年
行走在晨昏 交织的街巷
直面那时代 汹涌的浪潮
在考验之中 铸成了铠甲

Pre-Chorus 2
到如今我们 仍目光明亮
怀揣着初心 奔赴向远方
以义无反顾 坚定的模样
赢得了岁月 馈赠的勋章

Chorus 2
让信念化作 那漫天星光
照亮这土地 深沉的渴望
让热忱燃成 不灭的火焰
在风雨之中 骄傲地意立

Bridge
以真诚为舟 破开了迷雾
以热忱为翼 翱翔于天幕
用服务之手 传递的温度
续写那未来 崭新的荣光

Chorus 3
让信念化作 那漫天星光
闪耀在所有 期待的眼眶
让热忱燃成 荣耀的火焰
让美迹之名 在世界回响

Outro
众志汇成城 笃行永不息
绘青春美迹 绽放在天地

便写下故事 名叫做美迹

照亮这土地 深沉的渴望

在风雨之中 骄傲的意立

Verse 2

行走在晨昏 交织的街巷

Pre-Chorus 2
到如今我们 仍目光明亮

Chorus 2
让信念化作 那漫天星光
照亮这土地 深沉的渴望
让热忱燃成 不灭的火焰
在风雨之中 骄傲地意立

Bridge
以真诚为舟 破开了迷雾
以热忱为翼 翱翔于天幕
用服务之手 传递的温度
续写那未来 崭新的荣光

Chorus 3
让信念化作 那漫天星光
闪耀在所有 期待的眼眶
让热忱燃成 荣耀的火焰
让美迹之名 在世界回响

Outro
众志汇成城 笃行永不息
绘青春美迹 绽放在天地

asr_repeats.text: 以热爱为枝铺展晨曦，以理想为笔挥洒出篇章。当烛影回响，在河河圣地，编写故事名叫《最美记忆》。曾在风雨中将根茎深埋，曾在风浪里把梦想承载。穿越了岁月，跨越雨荆棘，守护着心中不灭的微光。让信念化作那满天星光，照亮这土地深沉的渴望。让热忱燃成不灭的火焰，在风雨之中骄傲的屹立。这些年我们如追光青年，行走在晨昏交织的街巷。直面那时代汹涌的浪潮，在考验之中铸成了铠甲。到了今我们仍目光明亮，怀揣着初心奔赴向远方。以无凡骨坚定的模样，赢得了岁月雨赠的勋章。让信念化作那满天星光，照亮这土地深沉的渴望。让热忱燃成不灭的火焰，在风雨之中骄傲的屹立。以真诚为手破开了迷雾，以热忱为腰向雨天怒。用朴实手传递的温度，续写那未来崭新的荣光。让信念化作那满天星光，闪耀在所有期待的眼眶。让热忱燃成荣耀的火焰，让美景之名在世间回响。终是会成长，多心永不息，汇青春美景，绽放在天地。

target.control_prompt:
我五岁的时候
看着别人吃冰棒流口水
五分钱一根
我没钱
那天太阳很烈
风也燥
连心都被晒得发烫

后来
我从二哥口袋里
偷了五块钱
手在抖
心在跳
冰棒在嘴里化开
甜得发苦
像被良心咬了一口

上初一那年
家离学校有一小时的路
看着同学骑车经过
阳光在他们笑里闪光
我低着头
脚下的灰尘
都在嘲笑我穷

十四岁那年
我在工地打工
门口停着一辆破旧的单车
已经落满灰尘
我看了它三天
终于狠下心
骑回乡下
三小时的风
在耳边骂我
也在哭我

后来我再也没偷过
我懂了
人不是生来坏的
是生活逼着你
去跨过那条不该过的线

有人被环境吞没
有人被良心救回
我庆幸
那天风声里
我听见自己的心在喊
别忘了你是谁

人性不是非黑即白
善恶之间
总有一盏灯
照亮回家的路

asr_repeats.text: 我五岁的时候看着别人吃冰棒流口水，五分钱一根我没钱。那天太阳很烈，风也骚，脸心都被晒得发烫。后来我从二哥口袋里偷了五块钱，手在兜心在跳，冰棒在嘴里化开，甜得发苦，像被良心咬了一口。上初一那年，家里学校有一小时的路，看着同学骑车经过，阳光在他们笑里闪光。我低着头，脚下的灰尘都在嘲笑我穷。十四岁那年我在工地打工，能够听着一辆破旧的单车，已经落满灰尘。我看了他三天，终于狠下心去回乡下。三小时的风在耳边把我也在哭我。后来我在夜外透过我懂了，人不是生来坏的，是生活逼着你去跨过那条不该过的线。有人被环境吞没，有人被良心救回。我静心听风声里，我听见自己的心在喊别忘了你。是真不是非黑即白，善恶之间总有一盏灯照亮回家的路。

target.control_prompt:
我五岁的时候
看着别人吃冰棒流口水
五分钱一根
我没钱
那天太阳很烈
风也燥
连心都被晒得发烫

后来
我从二哥口袋里
偷了五块钱
手在抖
心在跳
冰棒在嘴里化开
甜得发苦
像被良心咬了一口

上初一那年
家离学校有一小时的路
看着同学骑车经过
阳光在他们笑里闪光
我低着头
脚下的灰尘
都在嘲笑我穷

十四岁那年
我在工地打工
门口停着一辆破旧的单车
已经落满灰尘
我看了它三天
终于狠下心
骑回乡下
三小时的风
在耳边骂我
也在哭我

后来我再也没偷过
我懂了
人不是生来坏的
是生活逼着你
去跨过那条不该过的线

有人被环境吞没
有人被良心救回
我庆幸
那天风声里
我听见自己的心在喊
别忘了你是谁

人性不是非黑即白
善恶之间
总有一盏灯
照亮回家的路

asr_repeats.text: 我五岁的时候看着别人吃冰棒流口水，五分钱一根我没钱。那天太阳很烈，风也燥，脸心都被晒得发烫。后来我从二个口袋里偷了五块钱，守在豆心在跳，冰棒在嘴里化开甜得发苦。想昧良心要了一口。初一那年家里学校有一小时的路，看着同学骑车经过，阳光在他们笑脸上光。我低着头，脚下的灰尘都在嘲笑我穷。十四岁那年我在工地打工，门口停着一辆破旧的单车，已经落了灰尘。我看了三天，终于狠下心骑回家。三小时的风在耳边，我也在哭，我要变马。后来我再也没偷过，我懂了。人不是生来坏的，是生活逼着你去跨过那条不该过的线。有人被环境吞没，有人被良心救回。我庆幸那天风声里我听见自己的心在喊，别忘了你是。人生幸福是灰黑起白山之，总有一盏灯照亮回家的路。

asr_repeats.text: From as steel she rose like Phoenix light, the stars bowed their heads to her radiant might. Eyes on fire, the eternal flame under by her blade, the cosmos was won. The Queen, all Empress, divine and supreme, the Emperor of stars, the architect of dreams. All worlds tremble, all heavens sing, held to the Empress, the galaxy's queen. A world of rain, all but love were thrown. She shattered the chains of the small and the low, with fire and steel she forged dominion. Her voice like thunder, her will like rain. Flanks of flames, they whispered her name in awe, all earth in flame. The Queen, all Empress, divine and supreme, the Emperor of stars, the architect of dreams. All worlds tremble, all heavens sing, held to the Empress, the galaxy's queen. Her crown, a halo of slay of fire. Her eyes, the stars are kneeling in awe. The dragon heart, her eternal prize in her shadow, the cosmos lights.
